cards.meaning: slipped through, got past unchecked — passed without scrutiny or without being stopped; root: lusot
cards.example: Nakalusot sa Senado ang badyet nang walang tanong.
cards.exampleMeaning: The budget slipped through the Senate without a single question.
cards.note: May bahid ng biro o pang-uuyam: dapat may humarang pero wala. Iba sa 'pumasa' (dumaan sa pagsusuri at nagtagumpay). Kaugnay: 'lusot na' (nakaligtas sa parusa), 'palusot' (dahilang inimbento).
cards.tiesTo: Senate passes the OVP's ₱785.2M 2027 budget in about a minute, no questions

cards.meaning: squandering or misappropriating money, especially funds that are not one's own (public funds); root: lustay
cards.example: Kinasuhan ang opisyal ng paglustay ng pondo para sa flood control.
cards.exampleMeaning: The official was charged with misappropriating flood-control funds.
cards.note: Pormal, pambalita at pang-korte. Mas mabigat kaysa 'pag-aaksaya' (puwedeng kapabayaan lang): may bigat ng pagnanakaw o pagtataksil sa tiwala. Pandiwa: lumustay, nilustay, nilulustay.
cards.tiesTo: Romualdez seeks reversal of 90-day suspension in ₱7.44B flood-control plunder case

cards.meaning: won't go so far as; not as bad as — caps how far a situation goes
cards.example: 公司的现金很紧张，但还不至于违约。
cards.examplePinyin: Gōngsī de xiànjīn hěn jǐnzhāng, dàn hái bú zhìyú wéiyuē.
cards.exampleMeaning: The company's cash is very tight, but it won't go so far as default.
cards.note: Abstract connective-adverb, neutral/slightly 口语 but common in market commentary. vs 未必 ('not necessarily' — probability); 不至于 judges degree. Collocations: 还不至于…, 不至于违约, 不至于崩盘.
cards.tiesTo: Vanke seeks 3-year delay on ¥1.2B note; Shenzhen Metro support keeps it short of default

cards.meaning: to drag out, stall, delay (often as a tactic)
cards.example: 开发商一再拖延还款，债权人越来越不满。
cards.examplePinyin: Kāifāshāng yízài tuōyán huánkuǎn, zhàiquánrén yuèláiyuè bùmǎn.
cards.exampleMeaning: The developer keeps dragging out repayment, and creditors are increasingly unhappy.
cards.note: Neutral-to-negative. vs 推迟 (neutral 'postpone/reschedule'): 拖延 implies foot-dragging. Collocations: 拖延还款, 拖延时间 (play for time), 一再拖延.
cards.tiesTo: Vanke asks bondholders for 3 more years with under half the January upfront cash
